'''Galaan''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector's]] [[Galaanus system]]. Its local day lasted 132 standard hours; its year lasted 479 local days.

==History==
Its north pole was home to Corva sector's primary [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] communications station and [[New Republic Intelligence Service|NRI]] base. The base was discovered and [[Assault on Galaan|destroyed]] by the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] after the [[Thrawn campaign]].
